title: BACAM: Behavior-Aware Continual Agent Merging for Multi-Turn Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2610.04966v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Model merging offers a way to integrate the capabilities of specialized experts, but existing agent merging methods typically require all of them to be available at once. We study continual agent merging, which integrates incoming experts sequentially without retaining previously merged experts. Yet merging in parameter space or feature subspaces does not ensure that the merged model acquires an incoming expert's behavior on interaction trajectories. Moreover, updates toward a new expert can disrupt the merged model's previously integrated interactive behavior. Therefore, we propose Behavior-Aware Continual Agent Merging (BACAM), which learns parameter-wise merging gates from candidate-generated trajectories using expert-guided behavioral supervision. translated_title: BACAM：面向多轮交互的行为感知持续智能体合并
translated_abstract: 模型合并提供了一种整合专业化专家模型能力的方法，但现有的智能体合并方法通常要求所有专家模型同时可用。我们研究持续智能体合并问题，即按顺序整合新到来的专家模型，而无需保留之前已合并的专家模型。然而，在参数空间或特征子空间中进行合并，并不能保证合并后的模型在交互轨迹上获得新专家的行为。此外，向新专家方向的更新可能会破坏合并模型之前已整合的交互行为。因此，我们提出了行为感知持续智能体合并方法（BACAM），该方法利用专家引导的行为监督，从候选模型生成的轨迹中学习参数级合并门控。任务级的稳定性-可塑性控制和张量级的冲突感知更新预算，在限制对现有能力干扰的同时，允许模型获取新能力。
tldr: 提出BACAM方法，利用专家引导的行为监督从候选生成的轨迹中学习参数级合并门控，并结合任务级稳定性-可塑性控制与张量级冲突感知更新预算，实现无需保留已合并专家模型的持续智能体合并，在获取新能力的同时保护既有交互行为。
en_tdlr: BACAM enables continual agent merging without retaining previously merged experts by learning parameter-wise merging gates from candidate-generated trajectories with expert-guided behavioral supervision, while task-level stability-plasticity control and tensor-level conflict-aware update budgets preserve existing interactive behavior during new capability acquisition.
